options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: auto_healing_policies
options.description: The autohealing policy for this managed instance group .

options.name: base_instance_name
options.description: The base instance name to use for instances in this group. The value must be 1-58 characters long. Instances are named by appending a hyphen and a random four-character string to the base instance name. The base instance name must comply with RFC1035.

options.name: description
options.description: An optional description of this resource. Provide this property when you create the resource.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: instance_template
options.description: The instance template that is specified for this managed instance group. The group uses this template to create all new instances in the managed instance group. This field represents a link to a InstanceTemplate resource in GCP. It can be specified in two ways. First, you can place a dictionary with key 'selfLink' and value of your resource's selfLink Alternatively, you can add `register: name-of-resource` to a gcp_compute_instance_template task and then set this instance_template field to "{{ n

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the managed instance group. The name must be 1-63 characters long, and comply with RFC1035.

options.name: named_ports
options.description: Named ports configured for the Instance Groups complementary to this Instance Group Manager.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: region
options.description: The region the managed instance group resides.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in GCP

options.name: target_pools
options.description: TargetPool resources to which instances in the instanceGroup field are added. The target pools automatically apply to all of the instances in the managed instance group.

options.name: target_size
options.description: The target number of running instances for this managed instance group. Deleting or abandoning instances reduces this number. Resizing the group changes this number.
